difficulty.label: exam_prep
difficulty.rationale: Student must read the period from a position-time graph (peak to peak = 0.5 s), select T = 2π√(m/k), rearrange to k = 4π²m/T², and compute ≈158 N/m. Distractors reflect plausible errors (using f, dropping a factor). It requires one representation read, one law selection, and a short calculation. The concept depth is moderate and the reading and arithmetic loads are fair, which suits a full mock exam.

difficulty.label: exam_prep
